objects.description: Primary C++ interface and precompiled regular expression object for the RE2 library. Thread-safe, non-copyable, non-movable. Provides matching APIs, rewrite/replace utilities, program stats, and access to compile options and error reporting.
Helper type-erased wrapper used to adapt user-provided output pointers to parsers for submatch extraction in the variadic matching APIs.
Configuration object for constructing RE2 instances. Controls encoding, syntax mode, matching behavior, logging, memory budget, and related flags.
Thread-safe helper for on-demand, leak-on-exit construction of global or static RE2 objects. Supports brace initialization like {"pattern"}. Never deletes the constructed RE2.
Hook payload describing a DFA state cache reset event: the budget and cache size at reset time. Used with hook registration functions in re2::hooks.
Hook payload for a DFA search failure event. Currently empty; exists to allow future fields while preserving API shape.

objects.definition:
enum ErrorCode {
    NoError = 0,
    ErrorInternal,
    ErrorBadEscape,
    ErrorBadCharClass,
    ErrorBadCharRange,
    ErrorMissingBracket,
    ErrorMissingParen,
    ErrorUnexpectedParen,
    ErrorTrailingBackslash,
    ErrorRepeatArgument,
    ErrorRepeatSize,
    ErrorRepeatOp,
    ErrorBadPerlOp,
    ErrorBadUTF8,
    ErrorBadNamedCapture,
    ErrorPatternTooLarge
  };
objects.description: Enumeration of RE2 compile-time error codes reported by RE2::error_code() and related diagnostics.
Enumeration of predefined option presets for constructing RE2::Options implicitly when building an RE2.
Enumeration of match anchoring modes used by RE2::Match and internal DoMatch.
Character encoding selection for pattern and text in RE2::Options.

Forward-declared helper class used internally by FilteredRE2 as an AND-OR tree of string atoms to filter candidate regexes before full matching. Definition is not present in this header; implementation details are unknown here.

Wrapper that manages multiple RE2 regexes and a prefilter (an AND-OR tree of lowercase string atoms) to reduce the number of regexes that need full matching. Add() constructs and stores RE2 instances, Compile() builds the prefilter and returns distinct lowercase atoms for external string matching, and FirstMatch/AllMatches/AllPotentials evaluate candidate texts given the set of found atoms. Not copyable; movable. Owns its RE2 instances and a PrefilterTree. Construction/destruction semantics and filtering details beyond the interface are not exposed here.

A class representing a collection of regular expressions that can be compiled and matched simultaneously. Provides methods to add patterns, compile the set, and match input text, optionally returning indices of matching patterns and error information. Not copyable but movable. Uses RE2 options and anchoring semantics. Lifecycle: construct with options and anchor, call Add() zero or more times, then Compile(), then Match(). After Compile(), Add() must not be called.
Enumeration of error kinds that may be reported when matching with RE2::Set. Indicates no error, that the set was not compiled, DFA out-of-memory, or an inconsistent result.
Structure carrying error information for RE2::Set::Match() when no regexps matched. Currently contains only the ErrorKind field.

Type alias in namespace re2 for absl::string_view, provided for backward compatibility so users can include re2/stringpiece.h and refer to re2::StringPiece. It is a non-owning view of a contiguous character sequence. Lifetime is tied to the referenced data; it does not manage memory. Note: this header defines only the alias; the underlying type and its API are defined in absl/strings/string_view.h.

functions.name: re2::RE2::RE2
functions.description: Constructs a compiled RE2 regular expression from a NUL-terminated C string pattern using default options. Use ok(), error(), and error_code() to check construction status.
requirements: pattern must not be null unless you intend construction to fail.
If construction fails, subsequent use should check ok()==false and consult error()/error_code().

functions.name: re2::RE2::~RE2
functions.description: Destructor for RE2. Releases resources associated with the compiled pattern.
requirements: Do not use the object after destruction.
RE2 is non-copyable and non-movable; manage lifetime accordingly.

functions.name: re2::RE2::ok
functions.description: Returns true if the RE2 object was constructed successfully (i.e., error_code()==NoError).

functions.name: re2::RE2::pattern
functions.description: Returns the original pattern string used to construct this RE2.
requirements: Returned reference remains valid for the lifetime of the RE2 object.

functions.name: re2::RE2::error
functions.description: If construction failed, returns a human-readable error string; otherwise returns an empty string.
requirements: Only meaningful if ok()==false.

functions.name: re2::RE2::error_code
functions.description: Returns the error code from construction or NoError if successful.

functions.name: re2::RE2::error_arg
functions.description: If construction failed, returns the portion of the pattern where the error occurred; otherwise returns empty string.
requirements: Only meaningful if ok()==false.

functions.name: re2::RE2::ProgramSize
functions.description: Returns an approximate measure of the compiled program’s size (cost). Larger values are more expensive.

functions.name: re2::RE2::ReverseProgramSize
functions.description: Returns an approximate size of the reverse-compiled program used for certain searches.

functions.name: re2::RE2::ProgramFanout
functions.description: Optionally fills a histogram (bucketed by powers of 2) of node fanout in the compiled program and returns the largest non-empty bucket index.
requirements: histogram may be null; if non-null, it will be written to.

functions.name: re2::RE2::ReverseProgramFanout
functions.description: Like ProgramFanout(), but for the reverse program.
requirements: histogram may be null; if non-null, it will be written to.

functions.name: re2::RE2::Regexp
functions.description: Returns the underlying internal Regexp for this pattern. Not for general use; intended for internal/advanced integration.
requirements: Returned pointer is owned by the RE2 object; do not free it.
Validity limited to the lifetime of the RE2 object.

functions.name: re2::RE2::FullMatchN
functions.signature: static bool re2::RE2::FullMatchN(absl::string_view text, const re2::RE2& re, const re2::RE2::Arg* const args[], int n)
functions.description: Array-based API: returns true if the entire text matches the compiled regex re and submatches can be parsed into the provided Arg array.
requirements: args may be null only if n==0.
n must be >= 0 and correspond to the number of elements in args.
Each Arg must wrap a destination compatible with the corresponding capture.
On match failure, pointees are unmodified; on conversion failure, pointees may be indeterminate.

functions.name: re2::RE2::PartialMatchN
functions.signature: static bool re2::RE2::PartialMatchN(absl::string_view text, const re2::RE2& re, const re2::RE2::Arg* const args[], int n)
functions.description: Array-based API: returns true if some substring of text matches re and submatches are parsed into args.
requirements: args may be null only if n==0.
n must be >= 0 and match args length.
Same conversion and pointee guarantees as FullMatchN.

functions.name: re2::RE2::ConsumeN
functions.signature: static bool re2::RE2::ConsumeN(absl::string_view* input, const re2::RE2& re, const re2::RE2::Arg* const args[], int n)
functions.description: Array-based API: matches a prefix of *input against re, parses submatches into args, and advances input past the matched text if non-empty match and success.
requirements: input must not be null.
args may be null only if n==0.
If the match is empty, input may not advance; callers should handle potential zero-length progress to avoid infinite loops.

functions.name: re2::RE2::FindAndConsumeN
functions.signature: static bool re2::RE2::FindAndConsumeN(absl::string_view* input, const re2::RE2& re, const re2::RE2::Arg* const args[], int n)
functions.description: Array-based API: finds a (non-anchored) match within *input, parses submatches, and advances input past the matched text if non-empty match and success.
requirements: input must not be null.
args may be null only if n==0.
Callers must guard against zero-length matches to avoid infinite loops.

functions.name: re2::RE2::FullMatch
functions.signature: template <typename... A> static bool re2::RE2::FullMatch(absl::string_view text, const re2::RE2& re, A&&... a)
functions.description: Variadic convenience wrapper around FullMatchN. Returns true if text fully matches re and (optionally) extracts submatches into provided destinations.
requirements: Each destination must be a supported type (numeric scalars, std::string, absl::string_view, std::optional<T>, T with bool T::ParseFrom(const char*, size_t), or nullptr).
Number of supplied destinations must be <= number of capturing groups.
On conversion failure, destination states may be indeterminate.

functions.name: re2::RE2::PartialMatch
functions.signature: template <typename... A> static bool re2::RE2::PartialMatch(absl::string_view text, const re2::RE2& re, A&&... a)
functions.description: Variadic convenience wrapper around PartialMatchN. Returns true if some substring of text matches re and optionally extracts submatches.
requirements: Destination argument types must be supported as per FullMatch.
On conversion failure, destination states may be indeterminate.

functions.name: re2::RE2::Consume
functions.signature: template <typename... A> static bool re2::RE2::Consume(absl::string_view* input, const re2::RE2& re, A&&... a)
functions.description: Variadic convenience wrapper around ConsumeN. Anchored at the beginning of *input; advances input past the matched text on a non-empty successful match.
requirements: input must not be null.
Destination types must be supported as per FullMatch.
If the regex can match empty, caller must ensure progress or break to avoid infinite loops.

functions.name: re2::RE2::FindAndConsume
functions.signature: template <typename... A> static bool re2::RE2::FindAndConsume(absl::string_view* input, const re2::RE2& re, A&&... a)
functions.description: Variadic convenience wrapper around FindAndConsumeN. Finds a non-anchored match in *input; advances input past the matched text on a non-empty successful match.
requirements: input must not be null.
Destination types must be supported as per FullMatch.
Caller must guard against empty matches to avoid infinite loops.

functions.name: re2::RE2::Replace
functions.signature: static bool re2::RE2::Replace(std::string* str, const re2::RE2& re, absl::string_view rewrite)
functions.description: Replaces the first match of re in *str with rewrite. In rewrite, \0 is the whole match and \1..\9 are capturing groups.
requirements: str must not be null.
rewrite must use only valid backslash escapes: digit references or \\.
Use CheckRewriteString() to prevalidate rewrite if needed.

functions.name: re2::RE2::GlobalReplace
functions.signature: static int re2::RE2::GlobalReplace(std::string* str, const re2::RE2& re, absl::string_view rewrite)
functions.description: Replaces successive non-overlapping matches of re in *str with rewrite and returns the number of replacements. Replacements are not subject to re-matching.
requirements: str must not be null.
May perform at most a fuzzing-controlled maximum number of replacements if FUZZING_ONLY_set_maximum_global_replace_count() is used.
rewrite uses \0..\9 as in Replace; consider CheckRewriteString().

functions.name: re2::RE2::Extract
functions.signature: static bool re2::RE2::Extract(absl::string_view text, const re2::RE2& re, absl::string_view rewrite, std::string* out)
functions.description: If re matches text, writes rewrite with backslash substitutions (\0..\9) into *out and returns true. Non-matching portions of text are ignored.
requirements: out must not be null.
text must not alias any part of *out (REQUIRES per comment).
Use CheckRewriteString() to guarantee success aside from no-match.

functions.name: re2::RE2::QuoteMeta
functions.description: Escapes all regexp metacharacters in unquoted so the result matches the literal input string when used as a regexp.

functions.name: re2::RE2::PossibleMatchRange
functions.signature: bool re2::RE2::PossibleMatchRange(std::string* min, std::string* max, int maxlen) const
functions.description: Computes an approximate lexicographic [min, max] range for strings that can match this anchored regexp, considering only the first repetition of infinitely repeated elements. Returns true on success.
requirements: min and max must not be null.
maxlen must be >= 0; determines maximum returned string length.
The approximation ignores subsequent copies of * and + repetitions.

functions.name: re2::RE2::NumberOfCapturingGroups
functions.description: Returns the number of capturing groups in the regexp, excluding the overall match. Returns -1 if the regexp was invalid on construction.

functions.name: re2::RE2::NamedCapturingGroups
functions.description: Returns a map from group names to the index of the leftmost capturing group with that name. Valid only while the RE2 exists.
requirements: Returned reference becomes invalid after the RE2 is destroyed.

functions.name: re2::RE2::CapturingGroupNames
functions.description: Returns a map from capturing group indices to group names (entries only for named groups). Valid only while the RE2 exists.
requirements: Returned reference becomes invalid after the RE2 is destroyed.

functions.name: re2::RE2::Match
functions.signature: bool re2::RE2::Match(absl::string_view text, size_t startpos, size_t endpos, re2::RE2::Anchor re_anchor, absl::string_view* submatch, int nsubmatch) const
functions.description: Low-level matching routine. Searches within [startpos, endpos) of text under the specified anchoring. On success, fills up to nsubmatch entries of submatch with match and submatch spans.
requirements: 0 <= startpos <= endpos <= text.size().
submatch may be null if nsubmatch==0; otherwise must point to an array of length >= nsubmatch.
For performance, do not request more submatches than needed; nsubmatch==1 or 0 is fastest.
Passing an empty text is allowed; note ambiguity for empty vs. no-match in submatch entries (data()==NULL for both).

functions.name: re2::RE2::CheckRewriteString
functions.description: Validates that rewrite is well-formed for this regexp and references only available submatches. Returns true if Replace()/Extract() cannot fail due to rewrite syntax.
requirements: error may be null if the caller does not need error text.
Call before Replace/Extract when rewrite originates from untrusted input.

functions.name: re2::RE2::MaxSubmatch
functions.description: Returns the highest submatch index referenced by a rewrite string (e.g., for "foo \\2,\\1" returns 2).

functions.name: re2::RE2::Rewrite
functions.signature: bool re2::RE2::Rewrite(std::string* out, absl::string_view rewrite, const absl::string_view* vec, int veclen) const
functions.description: Appends rewrite with backslash substitutions taken from vec[0..veclen) to *out. Returns true on success; may fail for malformed rewrite unless prevalidated.
requirements: out must not be null.
vec must point to at least veclen entries when veclen>0.
Prefer calling CheckRewriteString() beforehand to ensure success.

functions.name: re2::RE2::options
functions.description: Returns the Options used to construct this RE2.
requirements: Returned reference is valid for the lifetime of the RE2 object.

functions.name: re2::RE2::CRadix
functions.signature: template <typename T> static re2::RE2::Arg re2::RE2::CRadix(T* ptr)
functions.description: Wraps ptr so numeric submatch text is parsed using C-style radix: 0 (octal), 0x (hex), otherwise decimal.
requirements: ptr may be null to ignore extraction.
T must be a supported integral type (directly or via std::optional<T>).

functions.name: re2::RE2::Hex
functions.signature: template <typename T> static re2::RE2::Arg re2::RE2::Hex(T* ptr)
functions.description: Wraps ptr so numeric submatch text is parsed as base-16 (hexadecimal).
requirements: ptr may be null to ignore extraction.
T must be a supported integral type (directly or via std::optional<T>).

functions.name: re2::RE2::Octal
functions.signature: template <typename T> static re2::RE2::Arg re2::RE2::Octal(T* ptr)
functions.description: Wraps ptr so numeric submatch text is parsed as base-8 (octal).
requirements: ptr may be null to ignore extraction.
T must be a supported integral type (directly or via std::optional<T>).

functions.name: re2::RE2::FUZZING_ONLY_set_maximum_global_replace_count
functions.description: Sets a maximum number of replacements allowed by GlobalReplace(); intended for fuzzing only. -1 disables the limit.
requirements: i must be -1 or a non-negative integer.
Only use in fuzzing/testing contexts; not for production use.

functions.name: re2::RE2::Options::Options
functions.description: Default-constructs RE2::Options with sensible defaults (UTF-8, case-sensitive, etc.) and a default memory budget.

functions.name: re2::RE2::Options::Options
functions.description: Implicitly constructs Options from a canned preset (e.g., DefaultOptions, Latin1, POSIX, Quiet).
requirements: Canned option dictates initial settings; caller may adjust further via setters.

functions.name: re2::RE2::Options::max_mem
functions.description: Returns the approximate maximum memory budget for the compiled program and DFA caches.

functions.name: re2::RE2::Options::set_max_mem
functions.description: Sets the approximate maximum memory budget for the compiled program and DFA caches.
requirements: m should be a non-negative value large enough for intended patterns; too small may cause cache flushing or fallback.

functions.name: re2::RE2::Options::encoding
functions.description: Returns the text/pattern encoding (UTF-8 or Latin-1).

functions.name: re2::RE2::Options::set_encoding
functions.description: Sets the encoding for text and pattern interpretation (UTF-8 or Latin-1).

functions.name: re2::RE2::Options::posix_syntax
functions.description: Returns whether POSIX egrep syntax is enforced.

functions.name: re2::RE2::Options::set_posix_syntax
functions.description: Enables or disables POSIX egrep syntax mode.

functions.name: re2::RE2::Options::longest_match
functions.description: Returns whether searches use longest-match semantics instead of first-match.

functions.name: re2::RE2::Options::set_longest_match
functions.description: Enables or disables longest-match semantics.

functions.name: re2::RE2::Options::log_errors
functions.description: Returns whether syntax/execution errors are logged.

functions.name: re2::RE2::Options::set_log_errors
functions.description: Enables or disables logging of errors to ERROR.

functions.name: re2::RE2::Options::literal
functions.description: Returns whether the pattern should be interpreted as a literal string, not a regexp.

functions.name: re2::RE2::Options::set_literal
functions.description: Enables or disables literal mode (treat pattern as a literal).

functions.name: re2::RE2::Options::never_nl
functions.description: Returns whether \n is never matched, even if present in the regexp.

functions.name: re2::RE2::Options::set_never_nl
functions.description: Enables or disables matching of newlines.

functions.name: re2::RE2::Options::dot_nl
functions.description: Returns whether '.' matches newlines as well.

functions.name: re2::RE2::Options::set_dot_nl
functions.description: Enables or disables '.' matching newlines.

functions.name: re2::RE2::Options::never_capture
functions.description: Returns whether all parentheses are parsed as non-capturing.

functions.name: re2::RE2::Options::set_never_capture
functions.description: Enables or disables never-capture mode.

functions.name: re2::RE2::Options::case_sensitive
functions.description: Returns whether matching is case-sensitive (unless overridden by inline flags and modes).

functions.name: re2::RE2::Options::set_case_sensitive
functions.description: Enables or disables case-sensitive matching.

functions.name: re2::RE2::Options::perl_classes
functions.description: In POSIX mode only, returns whether Perl character classes (\d, \s, \w, etc.) are allowed.

functions.name: re2::RE2::Options::set_perl_classes
functions.description: In POSIX mode only, enables or disables Perl character classes.

functions.name: re2::RE2::Options::word_boundary
functions.description: In POSIX mode only, returns whether \b and \B are allowed.

functions.name: re2::RE2::Options::set_word_boundary
functions.description: In POSIX mode only, enables or disables \b/\B word boundary operators.

functions.name: re2::RE2::Options::one_line
functions.description: In POSIX mode only, returns whether ^ and $ match only start and end of the text (not embedded newlines).

functions.name: re2::RE2::Options::set_one_line
functions.description: In POSIX mode only, enables or disables one-line mode for ^ and $.

functions.name: re2::RE2::Options::Copy
functions.description: Copies all option fields from src into this Options.

functions.name: re2::RE2::Options::ParseFlags
functions.description: Returns a bitmask of parse flags corresponding to the current Options. Intended for internal use when compiling the regexp.

functions.name: re2::RE2::Arg::Arg
functions.description: Default-constructs an Arg that performs no parsing (equivalent to Arg(nullptr)).

functions.name: re2::RE2::Arg::Arg
functions.description: Constructs an Arg that ignores the corresponding capture (no parsing).

functions.name: re2::RE2::Arg::Parse
functions.signature: bool re2::RE2::Arg::Parse(const char* str, size_t n) const
functions.description: Parses the submatch string [str, str+n) into the wrapped destination using the stored parser.
requirements: If the destination pointer captured by this Arg is null, parsing is treated as a no-op and succeeds.
str may be null to represent an optional submatch absence for std::optional<T>; behavior depends on parser.

functions.name: re2::LazyRE2::operator*
functions.description: Provides reference-like access to the lazily constructed RE2 object, creating it on first use.
requirements: The LazyRE2 must have been initialized with a pattern (e.g., via braced initialization).
Thread-safe creation via absl::call_once.

functions.name: re2::LazyRE2::operator->
functions.description: Provides pointer-like access to the lazily constructed RE2 object, creating it on first use.
requirements: Same as operator*; returned pointer remains valid for program lifetime (LazyRE2 never deletes it).

functions.name: re2::LazyRE2::get
functions.description: Returns the lazily constructed RE2*, constructing it on first call. Safe for static/global initialization patterns.
requirements: Pattern/options fields of LazyRE2 must be initialized before first call.
Never deletes the RE2; memory intentionally leaks by design for static usage.

functions.name: re2::hooks::SetDFAStateCacheResetHook
functions.description: Registers a callback invoked when a DFA state cache is reset (e.g., due to budget limits).
requirements: cb may be null to clear the hook.
Hook implementations must not assume lifetime of any context beyond the call and must not use RE2::Match() (per comments).

functions.name: re2::hooks::GetDFAStateCacheResetHook
functions.description: Returns the currently registered DFAStateCacheReset hook callback pointer, or null if none.
requirements: Returned pointer is owned by the hooks system; do not free.

functions.name: re2::hooks::SetDFASearchFailureHook
functions.description: Registers a callback invoked when a DFA search fails (details TBD).
requirements: cb may be null to clear the hook.
Hook implementations must not assume lifetime of any context beyond the call and must not use RE2::Match() (per comments).

functions.name: re2::hooks::GetDFASearchFailureHook
functions.description: Returns the currently registered DFASearchFailure hook callback pointer, or null if none.
requirements: Returned pointer is owned by the hooks system; do not free.

functions.name: re2::FilteredRE2::FilteredRE2
functions.description: Default-constructs an empty FilteredRE2 filter wrapper with no regexps added yet. Intended to be followed by Add() calls and then Compile() to build the prefilter. After construction, the instance can be used to add patterns and perform matching.
requirements: None beyond standard C++ object construction semantics.

functions.name: re2::FilteredRE2::FilteredRE2
functions.description: Constructs an empty FilteredRE2 with a specified minimum atom length used in its internal prefiltering logic. After construction, call Add() for patterns and then Compile() to build the prefilter.
requirements: min_atom_len constraints are not documented in this header; valid range is unknown.
No other requirements beyond standard C++ object construction.

functions.name: re2::FilteredRE2::FilteredRE2
functions.description: Move-constructs a FilteredRE2 by taking ownership of the internal state (regex list and prefilter) from another instance. Useful for efficient transfers without copying.
requirements: other must be an rvalue FilteredRE2 (e.g., std::move(other)).
After the move, the moved-from object remains valid but in an unspecified state and should only be destroyed or assigned to.

functions.name: re2::FilteredRE2::~FilteredRE2
functions.description: Destructor for FilteredRE2. Cleans up internal resources, including any RE2 instances it owns.
requirements: Do not use the object after destruction.

functions.name: re2::FilteredRE2::operator=
functions.description: Move-assigns from another FilteredRE2, transferring ownership of the internal state. Existing state in the target is released, then replaced by other's state.
requirements: other must be an rvalue FilteredRE2 (e.g., std::move(other)).
After the move, the moved-from object remains valid but in an unspecified state and should only be destroyed or assigned to.
Self-move-assignment behavior is not documented; avoid self move-assignment if possible.

functions.name: re2::FilteredRE2::Add
functions.signature: re2::RE2::ErrorCode re2::FilteredRE2::Add(absl::string_view pattern, const re2::RE2::Options& options, int* id)
functions.description: Creates an RE2 object from the given pattern and options and adds it to the filter set. On success, assigns an integer ID for the added regexp via id and returns NoError. On failure, returns the RE2 constructor's error_code and does not add the regexp.
requirements: id must be a non-null pointer to an int; on success, *id receives the index of the added regexp.
pattern must be a valid RE2 pattern for the supplied options; if RE2 reports an error, nothing is added.
May be called multiple times before Compile().

functions.name: re2::FilteredRE2::Compile
functions.description: Prepares all added regexps for filtering by building a prefilter tree and returns (via output parameter) a set of lowercased, distinct string atoms to search for. Call this after all Add() calls. The caller should search for these strings in candidate texts (case-insensitive or by lowercasing the text) to produce atom indices for FirstMatch/AllMatches/AllPotentials.
requirements: strings_to_match must be non-null.
Should be called after all Add() calls and before calling FirstMatch/AllMatches/AllPotentials.
The caller is responsible for performing case-insensitive matching of returned atoms or lowercasing the search text when building the atom index list.

functions.name: re2::FilteredRE2::SlowFirstMatch
functions.description: Returns the index of the first matching regexp by trying each RE2 directly without using the prefilter. Returns -1 if no regexp matches. Can be used even if Compile() hasn’t been called.
requirements: text is the candidate text to test; no specific encoding or case requirements are documented.
May be called before Compile().

functions.name: re2::FilteredRE2::FirstMatch
functions.signature: int re2::FilteredRE2::FirstMatch(absl::string_view text, const std::vector<int>& atoms) const
functions.description: Returns the index of the first regexp that matches text, using the prefilter guided by the provided atom indices. Returns -1 if no regexp matches. Requires that Compile() has been called to obtain the atom strings used to form atoms.
requirements: Compile() must be called before this function.
atoms must contain indices of strings previously returned by Compile() that were found in the text.
The caller should have detected atoms using case-insensitive search or by lowercasing the text, per class documentation.

functions.name: re2::FilteredRE2::AllMatches
functions.signature: bool re2::FilteredRE2::AllMatches(absl::string_view text, const std::vector<int>& atoms, std::vector<int>* matching_regexps) const
functions.description: Finds all regexps that match text and writes their indices to matching_regexps after clearing it. Returns true if any matches were found, false otherwise. Uses the prefilter driven by atoms.
requirements: matching_regexps must be non-null; it will be cleared before results are added.
atoms should contain indices of strings returned by Compile() that were found in the text.
Should be called after Compile() has been called to obtain the atom set.

functions.name: re2::FilteredRE2::AllPotentials
functions.signature: void re2::FilteredRE2::AllPotentials(const std::vector<int>& atoms, std::vector<int>* potential_regexps) const
functions.description: Computes the indices of all regexps that pass the prefilter (potential matches) and writes them to potential_regexps after clearing it. Passing the filter does not guarantee an actual match; failing the filter guarantees no match.
requirements: potential_regexps must be non-null; it will be cleared before results are added.
atoms should contain indices of strings returned by Compile() that were found in the text.
Should be called after Compile() has been called to build the prefilter.

functions.name: re2::FilteredRE2::NumRegexps
functions.description: Returns the number of regexps that have been successfully added to this FilteredRE2 instance.
requirements: None.

functions.name: re2::FilteredRE2::GetRE2
functions.description: Returns a const reference to the underlying RE2 object for the given regexp index.
requirements: regexpid must be in the range [0, NumRegexps()). The function does not perform bounds checking; passing an out-of-range index will result in undefined behavior (likely a crash).

functions.name: re2::RE2::Set::Set
functions.description: Constructs an RE2::Set configured with the given options and anchor, into which regex patterns can be added and later compiled for simultaneous matching.
requirements: options must be a valid re2::RE2::Options object (initialized as required by RE2).
anchor must be a valid re2::RE2::Anchor value.

functions.name: re2::RE2::Set::Set
functions.description: Move-constructs an RE2::Set by taking ownership of the internal state from another set.
requirements: other will be left in a valid but unspecified moved-from state after construction.

functions.name: re2::RE2::Set::~Set
functions.description: Destroys the set and releases all associated resources.

functions.name: re2::RE2::Set::operator=
functions.description: Move-assigns this RE2::Set by transferring resources from another set.
requirements: Self-assignment with the same object is permitted but leaves the object unchanged by standard move-assignment semantics.
After the operation, other is in a valid but unspecified moved-from state.

functions.name: re2::RE2::Set::Add
functions.description: Adds a regex pattern to the set using the constructor’s options. Returns the index assigned to the pattern, or -1 if the pattern cannot be parsed. On parse failure, if error is not NULL, it is filled with the parser’s error message. Indices are assigned sequentially starting at 0 and are not incremented for errors.
requirements: pattern is an absl::string_view referencing a valid pattern string for the duration of the call.
error may be NULL; if non-NULL, the pointed-to string is writable to receive an error message on failure.
Must be called before Compile(); Add() must not be called after Compile().

functions.name: re2::RE2::Set::Size
functions.description: Returns the number of patterns that have been successfully added to the set. Can be called before or after Compile().

functions.name: re2::RE2::Set::Compile
functions.description: Compiles the set for matching. Must be called before Match(). Returns false if the compiler (DFA) runs out of memory. After successful compilation, Add() must not be called again.
requirements: Compile() must be called before any call to Match().
Add() must not be called after Compile() (i.e., no modifications are allowed post-compilation).
Caller should check the boolean return; false indicates compilation failure due to out-of-memory.

functions.name: re2::RE2::Set::Match
functions.signature: bool re2::RE2::Set::Match(absl::string_view text, std::vector<int>* v) const
functions.description: Tests whether text matches at least one regex in the compiled set. Returns true if there is any match. If v is not NULL, fills it with the indices of matching regexps. Callers must not expect v to be sorted; indices are in the half-open interval [0, Size()).
requirements: Compile() must have been called successfully before calling Match().
text must remain valid for the duration of the call (absl::string_view).
v may be NULL; if non-NULL, it must point to a valid vector<int> to be filled with zero or more indices.

functions.name: re2::RE2::Set::Match
functions.signature: bool re2::RE2::Set::Match(absl::string_view text, std::vector<int>* v, re2::RE2::Set::ErrorInfo* error_info) const
functions.description: Like the other Match() overload, but if none of the regexps match, it populates error_info (if not NULL) to indicate why, e.g., DFA execution failure. Returns true if there is any match; otherwise returns false and may set error_info.
requirements: Compile() must have been called successfully before calling Match().
text must remain valid for the duration of the call (absl::string_view).
v may be NULL; if non-NULL, it must point to a valid vector<int> to be filled with zero or more indices.
error_info may be NULL; if non-NULL, it must point to a writable ErrorInfo struct that may be populated when no match occurs.

data_types.description: A string interpreted as a regular expression in RE2 syntax. May include metacharacters, character classes, grouping, repetitions, anchors, flags, and escape sequences. Not necessarily valid; invalid patterns are handled by the API with error reporting.

An unconstrained byte string used as input text to be matched, searched, consumed, or quoted. May contain any bytes including NUL (except where C-string APIs require NUL-termination), non-printable characters, and UTF-8 or Latin-1 data.

A replacement/rewrite template string for RE2 Replace/GlobalReplace/Extract/Rewrite. Supports backslash escapes referencing captures: \0 for the whole match and \1..\9 for capturing groups, plus \\ for a literal backslash. May be invalid, in which case validation/checking functions report errors.
